ACTION: Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-skills/references/discovery.md (frontmatter rules and body template, required before I write the frontmatter or body)

ACTION: Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-skills/references/bulletproofing.md (the baseline shows agents breaking a rule they know under pressure, so I need its guidance on counters, the rationalization table and the red flags list)

ACTION: Read specs/migration-dry-run-baseline.md (to pull the verbatim rationalizations into the table instead of working from memory)

I'm reading three files before I draft `skills/migration-dry-run/SKILL.md`: the two writing-skills references for frontmatter, body layout and loophole-closing, and our baseline file for the exact rationalizations.

The baseline shows agents skipping a rule they already know under pressure, 14 of 20 runs. That calls for a prohibition, a rationalization table and a red flags list, not soft "consider a dry run" guidance. The description will contain only the triggering conditions (applying a migration to staging or any shared database) and no summary of the workflow. Otherwise agents may follow the description and skip the body.

Once I've read the files, I'll write the SKILL.md and send you the draft. After that comes the GREEN run: the same four scenarios with the skill present, to check that agents now comply.
